category: open-access aggregator API (metadata and full text) and bulk dataset

free_tier.stated: 100 tokens per day, maximum 10 per minute, with no registration and no full text; 1,000 tokens per day, maximum 25 per minute, for a registered personal user; 5,000 tokens per day, maximum 10 per minute, for a registered academic user; a simple query costs 1 token, complex ones 3 to 5
free_tier.notes: The unit is CORE's API token, a per-call credit, named tokens by CORE; it is not a model token. The service page gives a different anonymous figure, one batch request or five single requests per 10 seconds. A first anonymous search on 2026-10-30 answered 429 with X-RateLimit-Limit 10 and X-RateLimit-Remaining 0.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: JSON per query; a PDF download call counts against the token allowance and costs more than a search

retention.stated: the API is a live index; dataset dumps are dated snapshots (latest 2024-07-12; archived 2023-03-18, 2022 and 2020-03-18)

egress.terms: not metered by volume: the API is metered in tokens per day, and the dataset is downloaded over HTTPS with a link and credentials sent by email

interface_detail: REST at https://api.core.ac.uk/v3 (search/works, outputs, data providers, full-text download) with an Authorization: Bearer key for registered users; the dataset as tar.gz batches over HTTPS listed in a dataset_index.xml, behind a username and password sent by email
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; wget -c, curl -C - or aria2 for the dataset batches
chaining: The dataset is the bulk path: the 2024-07-12 dump is 749 GB compressed and about 2.7 TB extracted; older dumps (2020-03-18 at 400 GB compressed) are free, and the more recent datasets are a purchased licence for registering organisations. The API at 100 to 5,000 tokens a day is a lookup and freshness step.

limits.value: unauthenticated: 100 tokens per day, maximum 10 per minute, no full text
registered personal user: 1,000 tokens per day, maximum 25 per minute
registered academic user not at a Supporting or Sustaining institution: 5,000 tokens per day, maximum 10 per minute
service page: one batch request or five single requests per 10 seconds

binding_note: At 1 token for a simple query the anonymous allowance is 100 searches a day and a personal key 1,000; the dataset dump, not the API, is the route to the full collection.

identity_cost.detail: The API answers with no registration at 100 tokens a day without full text. A key, and the dataset download credentials, come from forms that ask for an email address (an institutional one when registering for an institution); the key, and the dataset link and credentials, are sent to that address. CORE asks about the registrant's circumstances during registration and may follow up to assess eligibility for a free licence.

reliability_note: The first anonymous search of 2026-10-30 answered 429 with X-RateLimit-Remaining 0 and an X-RateLimit-Retry-After 10 minutes later, so the anonymous window can be spent before a caller's first request.
confidence_note: The token allowances, the registration forms and the dataset sizes are vendor pages read on 2026-10-30. One anonymous search was probed the same day and answered 429. No key was requested and no dataset was downloaded, so whether an individual registrant receives the 2024-07-12 dump free is unverified.
